title: 30A East Stepping Stone Carriage House Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Charming Carriage House!* Perfect for Couples – A cozy and peaceful retreat designed for two* 2 Complimentary Bikes – Explore Rosemary...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Charming Carriage House!* Perfect for Couples – A cozy and peaceful retreat designed for two* 2 Complimentary Bikes – Explore Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach, Seacrest Beach, Alys Beach, and scenic 30A* Beach Gear Included – Enjoy 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella for easy beach days* Walkable to Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach, Seacrest Beach & Alys Beach* Near Shops, Restaurants and Attractions* Peaceful Inlet Beach Location* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Stepping Stone Carriage House, a charming and cozy retreat tucked away in beautiful Inlet Beach! Perfect for couples or travelers looking for a peaceful escape, this inviting one-bedroom, one-bathroom getaway comfortably sleeps two and offers the perfect home base for exploring the best of 30A. Inside, you'll find a comfortable living area with a queen sleeper sofa, along with a fully equipped kitchen that makes preparing simple meals during your stay easy and convenient. The cozy design provides a relaxing place to unwind after a day spent exploring the beach and surrounding coastal communities. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, a peaceful beach escape, or simply want a convenient place to stay while exploring 30A, Stepping Stone Carriage House offers comfort, charm, and an unbeatable location for two.** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door. **The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: Queen BedLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
